options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (node, edge, and group counts, the most connected node, nodes without connections, hidden groups).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for values in the tooltip and table.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Ids of hidden groups (legend toggles): their nodes and edges are not drawn and not reachable.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash?; axisColor?; lineWidth?; markerSize?; cornerRadius?; barRadius?; cellRadius?; sliceRadius?; boxRadius?; swatchRadius?; tooltipRadius?; controlRadius?; lineJoin?; areaOpacity?; gradient?; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Shared chart option; a network graph has no column concept, so it has no effect.

options.name: nodes
options.description: Nodes: { id: string (unique, non-empty); label: string; group?: string (color, shape, legend); value?: number >= 0 (radius grows with its square root) }. At most 1,000.

options.name: edges
options.description: Edges: { source: node id; target: node id (not the source); weight?: positive number (line thickness, table) }. At most 5,000.

options.name: groups
options.description: Group labels, colors, and legend order: { id; label; color?: 1-8; colorValue?: CSS color }. Default: groups in order of first appearance, labelled by id; nodes without a group share one labelled "Other".

options.name: directed
options.description: Draw arrowheads at edge targets.

options.name: seed
options.description: Layout seed (integer 0-4294967295): the same data and seed always give the same layout.

options.name: linkDistance
options.description: Preferred edge length in layout units (10-400).

options.name: charge
options.description: Node repulsion (1-2000).

options.name: pinned
options.description: Nodes fixed at a position in layout units: { id; x; y } (the coordinate space of positions). Dragging and Shift+Arrow add pins.

options.name: zoom
options.description: Zoom and pan: toolbar buttons, + / - / 0 keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag on the background to pan, Shift + drag to select.

options.name: legend
options.description: Legend of node groups (toggle buttons): auto shows it with more than one group, show always, hide never.

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback (an adjacency list: node, group, connection count, connected nodes with weights): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

options.name: patterns
options.description: Shared chart option; groups already differ by marker shape, so it has no extra effect.

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: nodeLabels
options.description: Node labels: auto (graphs up to 50 visible nodes), always, or none.

options.name: animate
options.description: Animate the layout settling; never with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or animation: 'none' (the final layout is then computed before the first paint).

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, date, and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl puts node labels on the left; the layout is not mirrored.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: positions
properties.description: Current node positions in layout units, by node id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same mark.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide an item programmatically (no event).

methods.name: relayout
methods.description: Run the layout again from the current positions; pinned nodes stay.

methods.name: unpinAll
methods.description: Remove every pin (no event); call relayout() to let the nodes move.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, timers, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: NetworkGraphPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A node was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused node. seriesId is the node id, series its group, value its connection count.

events.name: aui-node-pin
events.detail: NetworkGraphNodePinDetail: { id: string; pinned: boolean; x: number; y: number; pins: NetworkPin[]; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' | 'api' }
events.description: A node was pinned (drag end or Shift+Arrow) or unpinned (U); also announced politely.

events.name: aui-series-toggle
events.detail: NetworkGraphSeriesToggleDetail: { id: string; visible: boolean; hidden: string[] }
events.description: A group was shown or hidden from the legend.

events.name: aui-zoom
events.detail: NetworkGraphZoomDetail: { x: ChartZoomRange | null; y: ChartZoomRange | null; reason }
events.description: The visible window changed (fractions 0-1 of the layout bounds).

cssClasses.name: aui-network-graph
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title, description, and the toolbar (zoom buttons).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip--custom / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-row
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused mark carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty / __summary
cssClasses.description: Empty state text and the hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-network-graph--lit
cssClasses.description: A neighborhood is highlighted (focus or hover); the rest fades.

cssClasses.name: aui-network-graph__nodes / __node-group / __node / __node--pinned
cssClasses.description: Nodes (focusable marks, marker shape per group) and pinned nodes.

cssClasses.name: aui-network-graph__labels / __label
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden node labels with a surface halo.
